title: Elderly Man Standing on Porch, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length black and white snapshot of an elderly man wearing a flat cap, dress shirt, suspenders, and trousers, standing on the porch of a brick residential home. Clothes are hung out to dry on a line strung across the porch behind him. Handwritten on the back is the date May 31, 1948, capturing a slice of everyday working-class American life in the post-WWII era.
